objects.desc: Library Administration involves the planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling of library resources and activities to achieve the library's goals and serve its users. Notary services are also available.

objects.name: Special Collections
objects.desc: Special Collections includes the Union College Archives, special book collections, manuscripts, and other primary source materials which document the College's history and support and extend its curriculum. The mission of Special Collections is to collect these materials, preserve them, and make them available to anyone with a valid need to use them. Schedule an appointment on their website or via email!

objects.name: Permanent Collection
objects.desc: The Union College Permanent Collection (UCPC) holds over 3,000 works of art, including works by internationally recognized artists and objects from Eastern and ancient cultures. As an academic and cultural resource of Union College, the mission of the UCPC is to preserve and provide access to the collection to enhance the academic programs and the cultural life of the College community. Selections of the UCPC are on view campus-wide. Professors may request to use artworks for course instruction and research, either via class presentations for in-depth examination and discussion, or in conjunction with our online collection.

objects.name: Learning Lab
objects.desc: The Learning Lab is an open study space as long as no meetings are being held. There are desktop computers and large TVs to display content.

objects.name: Engaging Tech Lab
objects.desc: The Engaging Technology Lab (ETL) in Schaffer Library 205 is the one-stop shop for all things course technology on campus. Need help with a specific learning platform? Our friendly Digital Innovation Student Liaisons and Learning Experience Designer are here to bridge the gap between you and the resources available.
